description: Structural template for the investor one-pager and the follow-up email set. Defines the fields analyzed in every deck, the sections rendered on the page, and the layout and typography of each block. Contains no company-specific content: every value here is structure, label, or style.

analysis_fields.company_name: The company name exactly as written in the deck.
analysis_fields.tagline: One-line positioning statement or descriptor for the company.
analysis_fields.problem: The problem the company addresses, in 1-3 sentences.
analysis_fields.solution: The product or technology and how it works, in 1-3 sentences.
analysis_fields.why_now: The timing thesis: why this opportunity exists at this moment.
analysis_fields.market_size: TAM/SAM/SOM figures and the market narrative, with any stated sources.
analysis_fields.traction: Revenue, users, growth, pilots, grants, or other concrete traction metrics.
analysis_fields.business_model: How the company makes money: pricing, model, transaction structure.
analysis_fields.team: Key founders and executives with the background stated in the deck.
analysis_fields.ask: Raise amount, instrument, and use of funds.
analysis_fields.stage: Company stage, e.g. Pre-seed, Seed, Series A, as stated or clearly labeled.
analysis_fields.key_risks_retired: De-risking already achieved: validation, approvals, partnerships.
analysis_fields.competitive_moat: IP, exclusivity, network effects, or other stated defensibility.
analysis_fields.contact: Founder or contact name and email address if present in the deck.

objections.title: Too Early
objections.focus: Stage and evidence: whether anything is genuinely de-risked yet, or the round is funding a hypothesis.
objections.rebuttal_must: Name the specific risks already retired and the evidence that retired them.

objections.title: Market Size & Definition
objections.focus: Whether the addressable market is as large as claimed, or a top-down number masking a narrow serviceable slice.
objections.rebuttal_must: Separate TAM from the bottoms-up serviceable segment and show the arithmetic the deck supports.

objections.title: Competitive Threat
objections.focus: Whether a better-funded incumbent or a similar programme reaches the same outcome first.
objections.rebuttal_must: State who the real competitors are and what this company can do that they structurally cannot.

objections.title: Moat & Defensibility
objections.focus: Whether the advantage is durable or replicable once the approach is public.
objections.rebuttal_must: Point to the specific IP, exclusivity, data, or process advantage and how long it holds.

objections.title: Team Gaps
objections.focus: Whether the team can execute the next stage, not just the current one — commercial and operational depth.
objections.rebuttal_must: Map named people to the next milestone and be explicit about which seat is still open.

objections.title: Regulatory & Approval Path
objections.focus: Length, cost, and precedent of the approval or compliance route.
objections.rebuttal_must: Give the identified pathway, any regulator interaction on record, and the precedent it relies on.

objections.title: Capital Required
objections.focus: Whether this round actually reaches a value-inflecting milestone or merely extends runway.
objections.rebuttal_must: Tie use of proceeds to a specific milestone and reconcile it against the stated runway.

objections.title: Adoption & Payor
objections.focus: Whether the buyer adopts and who pays, even assuming the product works.
objections.rebuttal_must: Identify the economic buyer, the purchase trigger, and any adoption evidence in the deck.

objections.title: Valuation & Terms
objections.focus: Whether price and instrument are in step with stage, traction, and comparable transactions.
objections.rebuttal_must: Anchor to the stated terms and comparables; concede where the deck gives no basis.

objections.title: Exit Path
objections.focus: Who acquires this, on what trigger, and at what kind of multiple.
objections.rebuttal_must: Name plausible acquirers and the comparable transactions the deck cites, or say none are given.
